itinerary.title: Mumbai – Mahabaleshwar & Viewpoints
itinerary.description: Board the morning AC bus from Mumbai (boarding point and time confirmed at booking) and reach Mahabaleshwar around late morning. Check in and have lunch, then a shared car tour of Arthur's Seat, Elephant's Head (Needle Hole) Point, Kate's Point and Venna Lake (boating at own cost). Evening in the main market. Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Panchgani Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a shared car trip to Panchgani – the wide Table Land plateau, Parsi Point over the Krishna valley and Sydney Point – with a stop at the Mapro Garden food park on the way back. Evening free. Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Mahabaleshwar – Mumbai
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check-out, then board the AC bus back to Mumbai (reaching by afternoon/evening, depending on traffic). Tour ends.

itinerary.title: Mumbai – Mahabaleshwar
itinerary.description: Board the morning AC bus from Mumbai (boarding point and time confirmed at booking) and reach Mahabaleshwar around late morning. Check in, have lunch at the hotel and spend the evening at the main market – try strawberries with cream, chikki and fudge. Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Mahabaleshwar Viewpoints & Venna Lake
itinerary.description: After breakfast, a shared car tour of the best-known viewpoints – Arthur's Seat above the Savitri valley, Elephant's Head (Needle Hole) Point and Kate's Point – and the old Mahabaleshwar temple. Afternoon at Venna Lake for boating or a pony ride (own cost). Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.
